name: i-want-to-sleep
description: Say "I'm going to sleep" and the agent takes over for N hours on a guarded night-shift branch.

interface.shortDescription: Hand your session over for N hours. Wake up to a tested branch and a report.
interface.longDescription: Opens a night-shift branch, finishes the conversation's unfinished items, then keeps researching, scoring and implementing bonus features until the deadline. Stop hook keeps it running; PreToolUse guards block pushes outside the branch, destructive git, package installs and edits to CI, migrations, config and dependency files.
defaultPrompt: I'm going to sleep — take over for 8 hours
Take over for 2 hours, wrap-up only
